messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — SummitAI dedicated bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PST. Need final quota numbers, autoscale probe plan, and loadtest script. Who's on call? @Ben @Priya
Priya: I'm on call. Quota request approved: baseline 600 rps, burst up to 6k rps for 10m windows. KMS keys staged. Need confirmation on allowed model variants (float16 vs int8).
Ben: Confirmed I'll own autoscale + infra. Can we get traffic profile (p95 tokens, avg seq length)? Also, we should set fallback policy to 1x smaller model if latency > 500ms for 5m.
Devon: Model side: Recommend int8-quant variant for steady load, float16 for regens. Memory footprint ~28GB per replica when int8. Autoscale suggestion: min 2, max 30, target cpu 65%.
Priya: Ops constraints: customer expects <200ms p90. We agreed to 99th SLO 600ms. We'll try to hit p90 150ms. Also enable prefix caching for common prompts.
Ben: Load test plan: run 3 phases: smoke (100 rps, 5m), ramp (to 6k over 30m), soak (6k, 10m). k6 script ready. Command:
Ben: ```bash
k6 run --vus 6000 --duration 10m load-tests/summitai-ramp.js
```
Alyssa: :thumbsup: Add canary traffic route to dedicated pool during ramp. We'll hold rollback trigger on error rate >2% or p95 >800ms.
Priya: I'll coordinate customer enablement demo at 09:30 PST after soak. Also capture feedback via this doc: https://redwood.internal/summitai/onboard-notes
ops-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/summitai-dedicated-bringup. Pager duty incident channel: #pd-summitai
Devon: Note: autoscale config I pushed to staging env. snippet:
Devon: ```yaml
autoscaling:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 30
  target_utilization_pct: 65
  stabilization_window_s: 300
  cooldown_s: 120
```
Ben: I'll schedule the loadtest at 08:15; tagging SRE rotation. @Alyssa confirm ops window for probing (we have permissive quota).
Alyssa: Confirming ops window 08:00-10:00 PST. I'll be primary COMMs. After soak, we'll run a controlled traffic shift at +10% for 15m to validate burst.
Priya: :eyes: noted. Action items: Priya (confirm model variants) | Ben (run tests + monitor) | Devon (ensure staging config) | Alyssa (customer comms).
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll post results + Prometheus snapshots in this thread. Setting dashboard alert thresholds now.
Alyssa: Thanks team. If anything slips, escalate to #customer-success-runbook. :rocket:
